body.statement: If recorded SUCCESS derivations cover every relevant district and their context contractions assemble \(E\in\mathscr E(P_{\mathrm{obs}})\), then \(E(P_{\theta}(V))=q(\theta)\) for every \(\theta\in\mathfrak M_{\mathrm{ocsi}}(G,\mathcal C)\); every recorded divisor is strictly positive on this class.
body.justification: The positive branch must return a total observed-cell formula with checked denominators.
body.gap: Tikka et al. and Chen and Darwiche prove sound search rules but not sound assembly for this provenance-carrying exhaustive normal form.
